title: Conditional κ = 7.44714499649771e-4: eight completed bootstrap levels on #290
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extending #290’s three completed ordinary bootstrap updates to eight increases its conditional κ from 186178624839407/250000000000000000 to **744714499649771/1000000000000000000**, a strict gain of **292143/1000000000000000000** (2.92143e-13).

This is stacked on #290 at `739c3bb0ad0596f427e0a72a2ebeca23277217a3`. The new contribution is the research/finite-eight-frontier/ supplement and its CI workflow. Its 136 original source files, kernel word, sixty-replica banks, source manifests, complex supplier, licences and contributor notices are preserved exactly. The proof supplies eight sequential finite cutoffs and small-width completions; it takes no infinite-depth limit.

Scope remains conditional on the inherited weighted compiler/native-front, fixed-tape ordinary primitives, selector/common-cover, ancestor-chart, restored-row, prime/recovery, complex scalar/Lean and analytic interfaces. No all-size theorem or new Lean certificate is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed; Chafik Boukhalfa, Rohan Arun, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Dugongue and other upstream contributors retain their credits and disclosures.

Newer submissions, including #296, report larger bounds. This PR records a verified improvement over its exact #290 parent and a reusable finite-depth refinement; it makes no current-record claim. Subsequent frontier adaptations can be added here without withholding this reviewed contribution.

## Validation

- The unchanged original ten-stage verifier passed in 703.734 seconds, including all 19,406 formal columns in both directions, both integer decoders, all 4,765,800 bank assignments, kernel controls and original stage-omission controls.
- Both separately implemented rational moment engines derive the supplier bounds and exclude their adjacent grid points. All 47 strict assembly conditions and seven margins pass.
- The arithmetic ran normally and under -OO in 30.015 seconds total, with identical values and types and all 27 intended-reason negative controls in each mode. Actual certificates and concise source/resource evidence are included.
- Distinct AI source/proof and publication audits passed. The exact published combined public entry point passed locally in 751.875 seconds. Fork CI also passed its complete public replays on Python 3.11 and 3.13: https://github.com/M6LI/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38043054255.
- The fork's shared repository workflow passed all 52 jobs at this exact head, including all 16 verification groups on Python 3.11/3.13/3.14, ranked-pair replay and three formal packages: https://github.com/M6LI/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38043054206. This establishes the required groups through CI; the earlier local sequential attempt timed out and remains recorded as a failure. Fork CI is separate from upstream maintainer approval.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/requirements.txt
python -X utf8 -B research/finite-eight-frontier/verify.py --output /tmp/finite-eight-fresh
```

The command reruns all ten original stages before the normal/optimized refinement. The workflow runs this same command and preserves its first result or failure.
